name: Pleurotus ostreatus

tip_speed.note: 12.0 mm/day at 30 C on agar, one study; research/01 [23] gives 233 um/h at 22 C from a snippet

branch_angle_sd.note: default from Hopkins & Boswell 2012 (79 +/- 10 deg, research/09); not measured for this species

sensitivity.note: how strongly tips turn away from crowding; model coefficient

fusion_probability.note: chance a tip that meets a hypha fuses and does not cross; no measurement found

density_cap.note: hyphal density at which branching stops; tuning value

explore.note: stays inside its wood; tuning value

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found

inactivation_rate.note: from Rhizoctonia solani (Boswell et al. 2003, research/09); not this species (0.5 per day)

degradation_rate.note: none seen in 15 h in R. solani; small value so dead hyphae clear

passive_transport.note: diffusion between neighbouring segments; measured diffusion inside hyphae (1 to 2 x 10^-9 m2/s, research/10) is several times faster than the passes allow

soil.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

wood.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

litter.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

root.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

agar.note: how well it feeds on this substrate; from its ecology, not measured

transport_speed.note: no measurement for this species; near the 14.4 mm/h ceiling for motor transport and the 18 mm/h mass flow measured in Neurospora (research/10)

t_opt.note: fastest of 20, 25 and 30 C in one study; research/06 [36] gives 30 C from an abstract

cold_drop.note: cultivation practice: mycelium at 25 C, fruiting at 20 C (research/06)

wobble.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

avoidance.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

fusion_probability.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

uptake.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

turn.note: tuning value for the 4K engine; not a measured quantity

ecology.substrate: dead and dying broadleaf trunks; cultivated on straw

notes: Cultivated worldwide and the species with the most growth data here [18]. Reported (unchecked) to trap nematodes and to have a sequenced genome; intracellular spikes of 0.5 to 5 Hz and 5 to 50 mV are reported second-hand from Olsson and Hansson 1995 (research/04 [14]), and its relative P. djamor spikes at 2.6 and 14 minute periods [10].

spike_interval.note: about one spike per 70 min in mycelium on hemp (27 min in another recording); fell to one per 254 min under chloroform; extracellular recording

spike_amplitude.note: median 0.48 to 0.51 mV; extracellular. Intracellular figures (5 to 50 mV at 0.5 to 5 Hz, research/04 [14]) are a different kind of measurement and are not used
